## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5); confirmations: strong cross‑sector breadth versus a major megacap-tech divergence (AAPL, AMD, NVDA BELOW TREND while INTC, AMAT, AMZN ABOVE TREND) — favors Value/Cyclical tilt.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +26.18%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +13.93%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary: AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +8.51%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities showing Sector Weakness: Utilities (1W: -0.77%) — sector lagging. Technology mixed/soft: AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -2.84% | 1M: -6.58%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate weak: AMT (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5), cyclical bias.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CME (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -2.84% | 1M: -6.58%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -3.83% | 1M: -17.07%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select tech and REIT names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND — note MAJOR divergence: multiple large-cap techs showing 1W/1M mismatch (MSFT, META, TSLA) — tactical caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with rotation signs: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND offset by AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND. Tech breadth: 12/19 positive — sector neutral-to-mixed, watch leadership dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cyclical/steady: JPM (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +7.13%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND. Financials breadth: 14/20 positive — modest upside but news risk in card stocks (see sentiment).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive but mixed: UNH (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +2.22%) TREND EXHAUSTION, LLY (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +8.28%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Healthcare breadth: 11/15 positive — generally constructive but watch UNH headline risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals/value exposure (Energy, Materials, Industrials) given broad sector participation and top performer mix; reduce exposure to select large-cap tech names showing structural weakness (AAPL, AMD, NVDA). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth, but major-cap-tech divergences warrant position-level monitoring.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -3.83% | 1M: -17.07%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (6/7 positive) and Energy (7/8 positive) given momentum and bullish headlines. BEARISH: Utilities (2/6 positive) and select Tech pockets (Tech: 12/19 positive) as leadership dispersion may persist.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
INTC 45 resistance for continuation (ABOVE TREND), AMZN 150 support pivot (ABOVE TREND), AAPL 155 breakdown level (BELOW TREND), NVDA 520 watch for trend confirmation (BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ISRG (+80): Surge on da Vinci usage and FDA approvals — price confirmation needed (ISRG not in top list here). OXY (+60): Sale to Berkshire headline supports Energy; cross-ref: Energy names SLB/PSX confirming sector move. INTC (+55): 1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47% ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. PSX (+60): PSX (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +1.63%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
COF (-65): Credit‑card fee cap headline — COF price weakness diverges across sector (financials broadly positive). BAC (-55): Similar fee risk — BAC (not listed individually above) represents headline risk for card issuers. UNH (-55): 1W: +2.25% | 1M: +6.30% ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverges from price, monitor for policy/legal flow. ADBE (-50): downgrade risk in Tech — cross-ref: sector mixed, watch names tied to AI spending.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Cyclical style tilt. INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk: major-cap tech divergence (AAPL, AMD, NVDA BELOW TREND) and credit‑card fee headlines creating cross‑current sentiment to monitor.
